@about: Scan to BIM add-on (0.9 SU.1132). Words of the add-on only; the engine has none. Other languages fall back to English until the next translation run.
name: Scan to BIM
intro: Proposes the floors, walls, doors and windows of a building from a point cloud you have open. Each proposal shows how far it sits from the scanned points. You accept, edit or reject; nothing is drawn until you accept.
cloud.none: No point cloud is open. Switch on Point clouds in Settings, General, Add-ons, build a cloud there (open a model first), then come back.
cloud.open: A cloud of {n} points is open ({how}).
cloud.how.centre: centred on the model; check it lines up
busy.floors: Reading the heights of the points
err.noplanes: No floor was found: the cloud has no clear flat horizontal surface. Check that the scan includes the floor.
err.fewpoints: Only {n} points lie between this floor and its ceiling: too few to find walls.
floors.note: Found from the heights where many points lie on one level. A flat surface at least 1.8 m above a floor is taken as its ceiling; lower ones (a table top) are left out. This is a guess: type the heights if it is wrong.
f.thickness: Wall thickness to assume where only one side was scanned
level.create: No model level lies within 150 mm of this floor. Accepting makes a level {name} at {z} mm.
proposals.note: Read from {n} points of this storey; the walls from a slice of {slice} points 1.2 m over the floor. Distances are in the plan, in millimetres, measured against the scanned points (the number of points is in brackets).
from.points.tip: Both faces of this wall were scanned, so its thickness is measured.
from.assumed.tip: Only one face was scanned, so the thickness cannot be measured; this is the figure you asked to assume.
hfrom.ceiling.tip: The scan shows the ceiling above this floor.
hfrom.points.tip: No ceiling was seen; this is the top of the wall's own points.
hfrom.assumed.tip: Too few points to measure the height.
walls.none: No wall was found at 1.2 m over this floor. The scan may be too sparse, or the cut height may not meet walls (rectilinear rooms only).
done.propose: {w} walls, {o} openings and {f} floors proposed. Nothing is drawn yet.
done.preview: Shown in the plan view of the level, in the layer of this add-on. Rejecting or accepting removes it.
done.accept: Drew {w} walls, {o} doors and windows and {f} floors in one undo step.
preview.label: Show scan proposals
accept.label: Walls, openings and floors from a scan
disclaimer: These are proposals from a scan, to check against the building. Only rectilinear rooms are read. A shadow in the scan looks like an opening, and a wall seen from one side has no measurable thickness. Not a survey.
